How the app handles your data

“Fake Call” is an entertainment app that shows a simulated incoming call screen. It doesn’t require an account, doesn’t collect your personal data, and doesn’t send any data to the developer or to anyone else.

The app stores only what you add, on your own device: the fake contact names, the photos you choose for them, and your settings (delay, ringtone, vibration, language). This data stays in the app’s private storage and never leaves your device.

When you choose a photo, the app uses the system photo picker. It does not get access to your photo library — only to the single image you pick. The image is copied to the app’s private storage and is deleted when you delete that contact.

• Notifications: to show the incoming call and missed call notifications.
• Full-screen notifications: to show the call screen over the lock screen.
• Vibration: to vibrate the device while ringing.
• Wake lock: to keep the device awake for a few seconds during the delay timer.

The app does not request internet, location, camera, microphone, real contacts or messages permissions.
The app contains no ads, analytics or trackers, and shares no data with third parties.

When you send feedback, the app opens your email app with a ready message. It is sent only if you press send yourself, and then we receive only your email address and the content of your message. Facebook links open outside the app and are subject to those services’ own policies.

The app is for entertainment only. Use names and photos you have the right to use or have permission from the people shown, and don’t use it to impersonate anyone, to deceive others in a harmful way, or to imitate official bodies or emergency services.
You can delete any contact and its photo from within the app, and remove all data at once by clearing the app’s data in system settings or by uninstalling it.
The app doesn’t collect data from anyone, including children.
We may update this policy when new features are added. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.
For any privacy question, email us at: hh.programming.services@gmail.com
